title: Loss accounting policy
description: How production loss is accounted for a unit: the period grain (shift or plant-day), whether loss lines are computed from stops and measurements or taken from the OT-declared production loss event, where the target comes from, which accounting unit the declared event is booked against, whether stops are cross-checked against the declared shortfall, and the tolerance of the declared identity (planned - actual = shortfall). Plan: declared mode (docs/PLA_DECLARED_MODE_PLAN.md).

grain.description: Accounting period grain: one period per shift or per plant day.

dayStart.description: Plant-local HH:mm at which the plant day starts; used when grain = day.

lossBasis.description: computed = loss lines derived from stops and measurements; declared = loss lines taken from the OT-declared production loss event.

targetSource.description: Target of the period: the plan target, or the OT-declared planned quantity.

accountingUnitId.description: Unit the declared production loss event is booked against; null = the policy's own unit.

accountingProductId.description: Declared mode: product the declared figures are booked to when the unit runs several products and no plan covers the day; null = no fallback product.

stopsCrossCheck.description: Cross-check stop quantities against the declared shortfall and flag the difference.

identityTolerance.description: Allowed deviation of planned - actual - shortfall, in the event's unit of measure.
